name: orthomcl-plasmodium-and-cryptosporidium-not-toxoplasma
turns: Which ortholog groups contain sequences from Plasmodium and Cryptosporidium but not from Toxoplasma?
rationale: Contain sequences from a genus is at least one of its genomes, so no question about all genomes is asked: the Plasmodium list and the Cryptosporidium list each with a taxon count of at least 1, and the Toxoplasma list with 0. The answer opens the result on the site in one step.
